% Converted, ltx-talk. C-TITLEPAGE: use the class's OWN \maketitle with the five
% titlepage-element instances restyled, and KEEP the beamer title block.
%
% Against before.tex the title block changes in exactly two ways, both forced:
%
%   1. The folded subtitle comes out of \title into \subtitle. Under the H1
%      override below, the \\ in \title{Main\\\large{Sub}} makes the subtitle a
%      SECOND H1 -- naive.tex measures 2 where this measures 1. \subtitle is a
%      beamer command too, so this file still compiles as beamer.
%   2. \vspace{-4em} is re-tuned to -1em. Beamer's value compensated for beamer's
%      own title spacing; here it pulls the attribution up into the institute
%      line. A number, not a construct.
%
% Everything else is byte-identical to the beamer source, including \author with
% the emails and \\ inside it, \date{} empty, and the attribution as centred text
% after \maketitle. That construct needs no workaround on 0.6.2.
%
% The emails inside \author DO reach XMP dc:creator; the shared preamble fixes
% that centrally with pdfauthor= rather than by editing any deck. This fixture
% stands alone, so it sets pdfauthor here for the same reason.
\DocumentMetadata{lang=en, pdfversion=2.0, pdfstandard={a-4,ua-2}, tagging=on}
\documentclass{ltx-talk}

% A-HEADINGS on the title page: the stock `title' instance opens a MANUAL
% \tag_struct_begin:n{tag=Title} around a paragraph the kernel's automatic tagger
% also tags, so remapping Title -> H1 would nest P inside Hn and veraPDF rejects
% it. Replace the wrapper instead and let the automatic tagger emit the H1.
% tag-end is empty on purpose -- the element's own \group_begin:/\group_end:
% scopes the keys, and a default \tag_struct_end: would fire unmatched.
\EditInstance{titlepage-element}{title}
  { font = \Huge\bfseries , before-skip = 0pt , after-skip = 0.5em ,
    tag-begin = {\tagpdfsetup{para/tag=H1,para/flattened}} , tag-end = {} }
\EditInstance{titlepage-element}{subtitle}
  { color = black , font = \Large , before-skip = 0pt , after-skip = 2.5em }
\EditInstance{titlepage-element}{author}
  { font = \large , before-skip = 0pt , after-skip = 0.4em }
\EditInstance{titlepage-element}{institute}
  { font = \normalsize , before-skip = 0pt , after-skip = 2.5em }
\EditInstance{titlepage-element}{date}
  { font = \small , before-skip = 0pt , after-skip = 0pt }

\hypersetup{pdfauthor={A. Lecturer}}

\author[A. Lecturer]{A. Lecturer\\ \texttt{a.l@uni.ac.uk}}
\institute[Somewhere]{University of Somewhere}
\title[CSP]{Constraint Satisfaction}
\subtitle{Backtracking and arc consistency}
\date{}

\begin{document}
\begin{frame}
	\maketitle
	\vspace{-1em}
	\begin{center}
		Material adapted from: \\
		Russell and Norvig (AIMA Book): Chapter 6
	\end{center}
\end{frame}
\section{Assignment}
\begin{frame}
\frametitle{A frame}
Body text.
\end{frame}
\end{document}
